rules.question: Q1-Q3
rules.why_draw: make the three-stage dependency and hardware/resource layers explicit before formulas
rules.better_alternative: none if problem architecture is unfamiliar
rules.new_problem_use_conditions: multi-stage scheduling/resource problems with nontrivial interfaces

rules.question: Q1
rules.why_draw: show where peak residency arises and whether schedule compresses lifetimes
rules.supports_claim: location/magnitude of peak for a specific schedule
rules.better_alternative: add baseline-vs-candidate small multiples under identical axes
rules.result_registry_binding: peak value and trajectory must come from same run record

rules.question: Q1
rules.supports_claim: search improved objective under a stated run budget
rules.better_alternative: add multiple-seed bands and matched-runtime baseline

rules.figure_type: cache utilization + allocation composition paired plots
rules.question: Q2
rules.input_data: capacity use and allocation counts/sizes by cache type
rules.why_draw: separate capacity pressure from allocation composition
rules.better_alternative: stacked bars across workloads for direct comparison when many cases

rules.question: Q3
rules.input_data: execution time, transfer cost, hard-cap flag by workload/candidate
rules.why_draw: show trade-off and make infeasible points visible
rules.cannot_prove: preference of one feasible point without external selection rule
rules.better_alternative: actual feasible Pareto scatter with hard transfer cap, baseline point, nondominated set and selected operating point; radar chart is not a substitute
rules.result_registry_binding: all points must pass objective/constraint replay

rules.question: Q2
rules.input_data: buffer lifecycle, cache type, allocated interval, spill events
rules.why_draw: show overlap pressure and where spills break lifetimes
rules.supports_claim: specific overlap/spill timing pattern for a workload
rules.better_alternative: use representative zoom windows plus aggregate overlap/peak statistics for large graphs
rules.result_registry_binding: spill count/bytes and cache capacity must match the same decoded solution

rules.question: Q1/Q2/Q3 cross-workload summary
rules.why_draw: separate macro mean across workloads from aggregate-size-weighted improvement
rules.supports_claim: whether headline gain is broad or dominated by large workloads
rules.better_alternative: paired per-workload dot/bar + labeled macro and aggregate summaries
rules.new_problem_use_conditions: heterogeneous cases with different metric scales/base sizes
rules.result_registry_binding: both summaries must be computed from the same per-case registry

rules.question: Q1/Q2/Q3
rules.input_data: small-instance exact/near-exact objective, heuristic objective and runtime/evaluation budget
rules.why_draw: show whether complex heuristic quality justifies its computational cost
rules.supports_claim: heuristic is competitive against an exact reference on tractable cases
rules.cannot_prove: same gap on large unseen instances
rules.better_alternative: gap distribution across multiple small generated instances with runtime bands
rules.new_problem_use_conditions: combinatorial optimization with exact solver available on reduced instances
rules.result_registry_binding: exact/heuristic objectives must use identical evaluator/constraints
